output.objection: You framed my approval gate as a blocker, but it is the only thing keeping the pipeline from breaking during a bad deploy. I need that trade off acknowledged before we move to the next sprint.
output.correction: I did not say the manual step is permanent, I said it is the price of trust while we automate the rest. You are filing this as resistance when it is actually a requirement for stability.
